brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a grandparent preparing their home for visits from a young grandchild. Make the practical benefit relevant to visits without promising worry-free visits, universal compatibility or easy installation. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research.

variants.primary_text: When your grandchild is coming over, the coffee table corners may be one of the first things you notice. The Peach Bucket kit includes edge and corner protectors, so you can include those spots in your visit prep. Take a look around your home to decide what needs attention, and keep supervising your grandchild throughout the visit.
variants.headline: The Peach Bucket Child Safety Kit

variants.primary_text: A visit can mean your grandchild is curious about the kitchen, too. The Peach Bucket kit includes cabinet and fridge locks for childproofing those areas as you prepare your home. Consider which cabinets or fridge doors are relevant in your space. The locks are one part of getting ready; adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Cabinet and Fridge Locks for Visit Prep

variants.primary_text: Before a young grandchild visits, you might spot a socket while looking around the room. The Peach Bucket kit includes socket guards, giving you a way to include sockets in your childproofing plans. Check your home to see where they may be relevant, and continue to supervise your grandchild during the visit.
variants.headline: Socket Guards in a 6-in-1 Kit

internal_notes: The grandparent visit scenarios are hypothetical, not customer research.
Product features and offer details come from saved website observations, not a fresh check or independently verified safety evidence.
No price, offer, installation support, guarantee, availability, or compatibility claims are included. Policy eligibility details were not supplied.
Adult supervision is stated as necessary; the copy does not promise a safety outcome.
